title: Simple Habits for a Healthier Kitchen Drain
description: Preventing kitchen drain blockages comes down to daily care and simple maintenance habits. Avoid pouring cooking oils, fats, or heavy food scraps down the sink, as these solidify inside the waste pipe and P-trap. Always use a sink strainer basket to catch solid debris before it enters the drain. Every few weeks, flush the sink with hot water and mild dish soap to break up organic buildup. If water begins draining slowly, manually removing and clearing the under-sink P-trap into a bucket is a quick way to restore full flow. If slow draining persists, consult a licensed plumber to inspect your drainage lines.
